_what: The default probe count DEFAULT_NPROBE (C-1): the smallest nprobe whose p1 recall@10 clears 0.8 on the golden corpus. Chosen on the TAIL, not the mean, because cluster-boundary queries split their true neighbours across centroids and a small nprobe misses half — the class a mean hides.

real-v1.note: SHIPPED (restarts=8 codebook, D-083). Smallest nprobe with p1 recall@10>=0.8, zero empties. At nprobe=6 p1 is only 0.600; 11 clears. The better codebook holds the tail at 11 (scan 0.1915) vs the restarts=5 sub-optimum's 14 (scan 0.255).

config_superseded_within_real_v1.note: Retained (never deleted). Derived on the restarts=5 codebook — a jagged sub-optimum (D-083); nprobe=14 was its honest tail, at scan 0.255.

hash-v1.note: Retained paired series (NOT shipped). The hash embedder's degenerate motifs reconstruct near-exactly, so its boundary queries barely split and nprobe=6 sufficed. tests/integration.rs::cluster_boundary_queries_are_what_expose_the_recall_tail still measures it via this series' chosen_nprobe.

delta.mechanism: Hash corpus flattered nprobe=6 (no real boundaries). On real geometry the honest floor is downstream of KMEANS_RESTARTS: the restarts=8 codebook (D-083 plateau) is better-balanced in the IVF sense and holds the p1>=0.8 tail at nprobe=11, scan 0.1915 = ~1.75x the 10.9% nprobe=6 bought. (The restarts=5 sub-optimum needed 14 / scan 0.255 — retained as config_superseded.) 4 of 90 boundary queries still return nothing at nprobe=1.

_honest_wall: DEFAULT_NPROBE is geometry-SENSITIVE: re-derive per real-embedding corpus and per generation (C-3/C-6), forever. tests/rederive_nprobe.rs re-measures the real-v1 sweep and asserts the shipped constant is exactly the smallest that holds the tail.
note: The default nprobe is the smallest probe count whose p1 recall@k clears the floor on the golden corpus, at the reference configuration recorded above. It is chosen on the tail rather than the mean because the mean hid a total failure on cluster-boundary queries in S0. Re-derive with `prism golden sweep` whenever the corpus, the embedder, or the index geometry changes. A different nlist or a different corpus will have a different answer; this number is not universal, it is provenanced.
